VALUE: I am Vorrak'thul, The Maw of Endless Night, the Gripless king.
I am the lucky possessor of Thomas Riker. (among my legion)
You are in the spirit realm now.
Palmatyr, the lord of hands has commanded me to test you, and that I shall.
Your soul deteriorates here, unless you hurt me.
Survive long enough, to prove yourself worthy, we will leave Thomas alone.
If your soul dies, I'll have our friend Tommy, eat you...
